newsitem.title: USA: Medusa sees demand for cement continuing.
newsitem.headline: Medusa sees demand for cement continuing.

text.p: Medusa Corp said on Monday that it expects supply and demand for the cement market should remain favorable in 1997 if current trends continue.

The company today reported that third quarter earnings had risen to $1.38 per primary share, compared to $1.01 for the year-ago quarter. It said sales rose 16 percent from the year-ago quarter and attributed improved results to favorable weather that had increased demand and higher cement prices.
The company said it expects demand trends to continue and be reflected in year-end cement inventories that are lower than last year's.
